raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 contains a re-delivered copy of each of its 326 transactions (652 rows, 326 duplicated txn_ids) where txn_ts is epoch milliseconds instead of a formatted string. That breaks the TIMESTAMP cast. 1768716104000 ms is 2026-01-18 06:01:44 UTC, which is exactly the txn_ts of the original row for txn 904477, so these are true duplicates and need parsing plus dedup by txn_id.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.82, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_epoch, ingest_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'), dedup AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY is_epoch, ingest_ts) AS rn FROM parsed) SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE rn = 1;"}}
